name: Caesarea
line: Caesarea was a Roman port city on the Mediterranean coast, where Peter met the Gentile Cornelius and where Paul was held as a prisoner.

moments.title: Peter visits Cornelius
moments.text: Peter arrives in Caesarea at the home of Cornelius, a Roman army officer called a centurion, who feared God. Peter tells the gathered people that God does not show favoritism and welcomes people from every nation.

moments.title: Agabus warns Paul
moments.text: Paul stays at the home of Philip, a man who spread the good news about Jesus. The prophet Agabus says Paul will be bound in Jerusalem, and Paul answers that he is ready even to die for the name of the Lord Jesus.

moments.title: Paul brought to Felix
moments.text: Because of a plot against Paul, Roman soldiers take him toward Caesarea, and horsemen bring him the rest of the way. There they hand the commander's letter to Governor Felix, who orders Paul kept under guard.

moments.title: Paul appeals to Caesar
moments.text: Festus returns to Caesarea and sits on the judgment seat, and Paul's accusers bring charges they cannot prove. Paul says he should be tried by Caesar and appeals to him, and Festus agrees.
